name: Greater healing draught
description: A full bottle of crimson that smells of iron and cloves. It closes a wound the way a door closes on a draught.
notes: A greater health potion (mw-ju8.4), buy and use only: no brewing yet. Restores 100 health; the minor tier is the existing healing draught at 30. Base value 90 sits in the economy greater potion band. Magnitudes are a placeholder scale for the balance tool.
